paper_title: The first search for bosonic super-WIMPs with masses up to 1 MeV/c$^2$ with GERDA
notes: GERDA search for bosonic super-WIMPs (60 keV-1 MeV). Paper reports limits on both g_ae (ALP-electron, AxionElectron) and dark photon kinetic mixing alpha'/alpha. Chose AxionElectron per hint and primary text example (g_ae<3e-12 at 150 keV/c2, 90% C.I.). Only the 150 keV anchor point is explicit in text; other points estimated from Fig. 3 curve and are approximate. A parallel dark-photon limit (alpha'/alpha<6.5e-24 at 150 keV) also exists but is not encoded here.
